_comment: One editorial line per HP Click release, for the public version history.
The MEASURED columns on that page - macOS floor, Electron, architectures,
printer count - are not here. They come from clickgraft/data/capabilities.json,
which packaging/measure_capabilities.py writes by reading the real bundles. This
file holds only what a person concluded, so the two can never be confused: a
number on that page was measured, a sentence was written.
'published' is HP's own Last-Modified on the installer where known, otherwise
the date the build was first seen. Say so in 'dated' when it is the latter.

4.12.26.note: Adds an ink-levels panel: a read-only popover showing each cartridge's level and status, including whether it is non-genuine. Display only - nothing is blocked by it. Otherwise identical to 4.11.32.

4.11.32.note: Dependency refresh. Three vendored libraries moved and the stylesheet shrank; no feature surface changed. HP never published an app zip for it, and deleted the installer when 4.12.26 shipped.

4.11.31.note: The first build HP compiled for Apple Silicon throughout. No graft needed from here on. Also the release that replaced the in-app guide window with bundled PDFs.

4.10.42.note: Last Intel-only build. Reworked notifications and a new app icon. Never listed on HP's download page - it existed only in the auto-updater's directory.

4.8.118.note: Dropped seven DesignJet models: T310, T320, T350, T720 and T750. The change was an edit to a printer list file, not a rewrite. Never published as an installer at all.

4.8.117.note: The last build that lists the seven T-series printers, and the one ClickGraft grafts. HP deleted its installer in October 2026; the app zip is still served.

4.6.47.note: Newest build that still runs below macOS 12 - the one to hand someone on 10.14 or 11.

4.5.21.note: Point release before low-resolution loading arrived.

4.4.59.note: Point release. Kept as a second pre-4.6 reference.

3.7.83.note: The oldest HP Click for Mac that still exists anywhere. Everything below it returns 404 on HP's server.
